Description: This character served as the subject of a story set in medieval Europe that Jaiko was planning to write for her manga. He is a character from Arthurian legends.
This character appeared in materials created by Nobita for the public debate Does Nessie Exist or Not?. In January 1934, Arthur Grant saw a creature crossing a road near Loch Ness.
A robot servant of Princess Are Okkana. Chased by Akan Vader, R3-D3 fled from Planet Lilliput. When Princess Are was captured by Akan Vader near Earth, the robot escaped seeking help.
The princess of Lilliput. She looks a little like Shizuka and wears a large star-shaped necklace. She was attacked by Akan Vader's forces and fled into space, but was captured near Earth.
This is the entry Shizuka read aloud to test Nobita, who had memorized the phone book using Memory Bread. The entry appears above the alphabetical listings in the phone book.
Doraemon appeared in Nobita's dream as seen through the Standing Dream Stick.
Source References: TenComi Volume 16, Page 61; FF Land Volume 20, Page 166; Complete Works Volume 7, Page 304

Description: Albert Einstein was a German physicist famous for his theory of Brownian motion, his explanation of the photoelectric effect, and his theory of relativity. Suneo explained this to Nobita.
From The Screw of Life story. Einmotain was a stuffed cow brought to life by the screw. After receiving energy from a lightning strike, the cow gained human intellect.
A girl who lived next door to Nobita when he was in kindergarten. Her name is Nonko. Nobita played a prank and hid her red shoes.
A character from the musical The Birth of Heaven. He is the King of the Southern Desert who tried to conquer the lush, green land of the White King.
Invaders who attacked Planet Lilliput. Akan Vader wears a mask covering his face. He captured Princess Are Okkana near Earth, then landed on Earth. He secretly built a base underground.

Character Name: The Person Who Threw Away the Empty Cans
Description: Someone who threw an empty drink can into someone's yard. This person has an afro, wears sunglasses, and has a beard.
A burglar tried to break into Mr. Torigoe's house wearing sunglasses. The burglar tracked the residents movements and climbed over the fence to enter. However, Nobita and Doraemon stopped him.
The old man who owns the vacant lot where Nobita built a house using the Camping Capsule without permission. He came to complain about the unauthorized construction.
A demon summoned by Nobita using a demon-summoning tool. He was a very humble demon, crying and saying that hardly anyone called on him anymore these days. He gave Nobita the Devil's Passport.
The villain from the TV show Nobita watches every week. Thanks to the peace signals emitted from the Peace Antenna by his arch-enemy Mutekiman, he ended up becoming friendly.
In a magical world, demons and monsters are said to have existed on Earth long ago. They possess tremendous magical power. Originally, they were not evil.
On Animal Planet, a race is said to have ruled the moon visible from Nimge. Legend says that long ago on the moon, they oppressed the ancestors of the Animal Planet residents.
A character that appeared on TV Nobita was watching. He was hit with a swift punch by Grand Robo Deluxe.
Source References: FF Land Volume 3, Page 99; Plus Volume 4, Page 57

Description: Having lost his memory, he went into houses one by one searching for his own home. The Forgetful Hammer drives him crazy if he hits his head too hard with it.
A character whose related merchandise Shizuka collects.
A boy on a mystery tour and the son of a billionaire. Jane is Aston's friend. His body was taken over by a parasite.
Aston's father and a billionaire. He invested funds to rebuild Dreamersland, which was destroyed in an attack by Yadori.
This figure appeared when Nobita explained to Shizuka that it was right to be naked. Adam is a figure from the Bible, considered the first human created by God.
One of the ancestors of humankind who lived in the Garden of Eden with Eve. Adam ate the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge, which God had forbidden him to eat.
This character appeared in materials created by Nobita for the public debate Does Nessie Exist or Not?. In 565, Adamsen wrote about the dragon in his Life of Saint Columba report.
The Crown Prince of the Principality of Littlestein. During Shizuka's visit to Japan, she attached a letter to a balloon and released it into the air. The prince received it.
He lives in a small house with his mother and six siblings. The Christmas party was to be held at his house, but it was too small, so Doraemon solved the problem.
Abaratani Ichiro's mother raises six children in a small house. She prepared to leave the house for her son, who promised to attend a Christmas party.
Abaratani Ichiro's brother.
Source References: TenComi Volume 5, Page 23; FF Land Volume 13, Page 98; Complete Works Volume 3, Page 288

Character Name: The Old Man Who Runs the Dilapidated House
Alternative Name: Old Man in the Dilapidated House
Description: The owner of a traditional Japanese confectionery shop that looks dilapidated and is on the verge of closing due to poor business.
The main character of Dr. Stop Abare-chan. She is a strong and cute girl robot.
Source References: TenComi Volume 31, Page 148; TenComi Volume 35, Page 48; FF Land Volume 44, Page 98; Complete Works Volume 14, Page 488

Description: An Arabian slave trader who tried to capture Shizuka and sell her off. He had been rescued by Sinbad in the past and taken to the Golden Palace, and now he wants to seize the treasure.
The name Doraemon used when introducing himself to King Harun al-Rashid.
The name of the news announcer that Nobita's dad was watching.
Source References: TenComi Volume 36, Page 159; FF Land Volume 44, Page 181; Complete Works Volume 13, Page 601

Description: A professional singer selected to appear on the TV show Let's Become a Star. Gian aimed to win the championship and copied the voiceprint using a machine that captures voice patterns.
He appears in an anime that Gian watches in his room on the Galaxy Express. He is a fantasy-loving elementary school student.
A singer that Shizuka is a huge fan of. Shizuka wanted an autograph, so she sent a letter to the Get a Reply in Advance Postbox, but she did not receive a reply.
One of the ancestors of robots in Mechatopia. Created 30,000 years ago by a scientist who had become disillusioned with humanity.
A professional string figure artist who attempted the Great Finger trick. Her signature move is Great Forest.
The TV hero that Nobita watched. He wears a mask resembling an eagle. His body is decorated with a cape, but the legs are quite simple. He fights using low-level martial arts.
The name Nobita used when introducing himself to King Harun al-Rashid.
A master thief who appears in the works of French novelist Maurice Leblanc. Nobita used Arsene Lupin as a metaphor when he stole a book using the Devil's Passport.
Hans Christian Andersen was a Danish children's book author. He wrote The Little Match Girl, The Little Mermaid, The Ugly Duckling, and The Emperor's New Clothes.
A purebred Siamese cat kept as a pet in Suneo's house. Anna was found when Suneo's mother's 10 million yen diamond went missing.
An American writer who disappeared in late 1913 after traveling to Mexico during the revolution. His last known letter was dated December 26, 1913, from Chihuahua, Mexico.
The king who rules the planet Chamocha. Due to Dr. Napogistler's machinations, the planet Chamocha has been taken over.

Character Name: Head of the Flower Arrangement School
Description: The head of the flower arrangement school that Nobita's mother practices. He noticed her flower arrangement at the exhibition and praised her work.
The name that appeared in Shizuka's dream, inscribed on a tombstone.

Character Name: A Foreigner Who Collapsed from Exhaustion
Description: A Dutchman was found collapsed in an empty lot. He was rescued by Kawaru-kun and had a picture of Momotaro.
Source References: TenComi Volume 9, Page 163; FF Land Volume 19, Page 5; Complete Works Volume 5, Page 239

Description: Nobita's mom said that when she saw her own smiling face, it looked just like Junko Ikeuchi's.
Source References: TenComi Volume 15, Page 86; FF Land Volume 8, Page 56; Complete Works Volume 5, Page 169

Description: A woman who lives on Futatsuyama. She was offered as a sacrifice to Shirakami-sama, but managed to escape.
Appears to be an ordinary police officer, but his true identity is revealed by the Bowing Grasshopper. The Vietnam War, photochemical smog, and rising prices are mentioned in his story.
A small dog was tied to a tree in an empty lot. Thanks to the Animal Transformation Gratitude Potion, it came to Doraemon's house to repay him for saving it.
A stray dog became attached to Nobita after he fed it once. Nobita's mom found out he was secretly keeping it as a pet, so he used his time machine to take Ichi back 300 million years.
The address on an envelope was mixed in with Nobita's mail.
A character that appears in the picture book that Nobita owns.

Character Name: The Person Who Dropped the Bag Containing 10 Million Yen
Description: A man left a bag containing 10 million yen in a public telephone booth. He remembered halfway and went back, but the bag was already gone.

Character Name: The Person Who Found the Bag Containing 10 Million Yen
Description: A man found a bag containing 10 million yen in a public telephone booth. He ran as fast as he could and reported it to the police station.
A dog that always bites Nobita. He was bitten by Nobita using a One-Shot Reversal Bomb and ran away.
Source References: Plus Volume 3, Page 67; Complete Works Volume 8, Page 194

Character Name: A Child Who Is Always Timid and Nervous
Description: A boy who is Nobita's friend. The child is quick-tempered, easily frightened, and always timid and nervous. The boy did not want to go back to his grandfather's house.

Character Name: The Grandfather of the Timid Child
Alternative Name: Old Man Who Is Always Timid and Nervous
Description: The grandfather of a child who gets angry at the slightest thing and is always timid and nervous.
A female idol who is popular with Suneo and Doraemon fans. She was delivered to Nobita's house using a copying machine. She got caught up in a scuffle between Suneo and others.
A teacher who was very kind to Tsubasa Ito when she was in elementary school. He remains a trusted confidant for Tsubasa Ito. He is elderly and married.
A commentator for the world title match for string figures.
A dog cop in a winding city. Jack was speeding and crashed his car into a lamppost, completely wrecking it, so police cars rushed to the scene.
A boy who mistakenly addressed Nobita's New Year's card to Taiyama Saburo.
Source References: TenComi Volume 15, Page 168; FF Land Volume 25, Page 94; Complete Works Volume 4, Page 394

Description: Saburo Inuyama's father. Thanks to the power of the Portable Parliament, the kanji characters were changed to Taizan Kenro.
Source References: TenComi Volume 15, Page 170; FF Land Volume 25, Page 96; Complete Works Volume 4, Page 396

Character Name: A Girl Walking Her Dog (Gian's Crush 1)
Description: A girl Gian has a crush on. She often walks Benji in the park.

Character Name: A Girl Walking Her Dog (Gian's Crush 2)
Description: A girl Gian fell in love with. She was from Osaka and stayed at a relative's house for a while.
The large wild boar that chased Nobita's ancestor, Nobisaku. It was killed by Suneo's ancestor, Sunemaru.
Source References: TenComi Volume 1, Page 101; FF Land Volume 2, Page 8; Complete Works Volume 1, Page 203

Description: This figure appeared when Nobita explained to Shizuka that it was right to be naked. Eve is a figure from the Bible, considered the second human created by God.
One of the ancestors of humankind who lived in the Garden of Eden with Adam. Eve ate the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge, which God had forbidden her to eat.
One of the ancestors of robots in Mechatopia. Created 30,000 years ago by a scientist who had become disillusioned with humanity.
Shizuka created a giant rock golem using her Inanimate Object Hypnosis Megaphone.
The mayor of Animal Planet. He prayed to God and Nimge and devised a plan to fight. He is a leader of the townspeople who devoutly follow God's teachings.
An old man was tending his plants when something hit him on the head over the fence. When he rushed out to investigate, he spotted Gian and complained about vandalism.
Creatures resembling fish with arms and legs that inhabit planet Koya Koya. In winter, they come ashore, burrow into soil, and hibernate.
A male employee of the Senshin fish shop in Nobita's town. A cat thief stole a fish, and the employee chased after it with a kitchen knife.
An elephant living in Tanzania, Africa. He testified before the Noah Project council. His family was killed by poachers who wanted his ivory.
A doll that Shizuka was holding. Papi got on the rabbit and ran away while filming.
A high-ranking official in the imperial court. He was cured of his illness by Sunemaro.
At a celebration marking escape from Gigazombie and arrival in Japan, a man from the Hikari tribe performed a song.
A star appearing in a Japanese-American co-production film filmed in front of the train station.
A monster that appears in Space Exploration Pretend Play. The monsters attack, but since they are made of rubber, players can defeat them safely.
Suneo appears in Nobita's dream. Apparently, Suneo loses a space war against Nobita in the dream.
Source References: TenComi Volume 28, Page 88; FF Land Volume 36, Page 5; Complete Works Volume 10, Page 425

Description: A monster that appeared in Space Detective Saraba. Thanks to the One-Shot Comeback Bomb, he defeated the protagonist and brought the show to an end. In truth, he was just pretending.
Nobita found a balloon he was remotely controlling with the Long-Range Balloon Letter Controller. The balloon arrived at Nobita's house late at night with a letter attached.
Nobita's favorite TV hero. He was naked from the waist up, wearing only cloth on his lower body, and holding something resembling a dagger in his left hand. He fought evil creatures.

Character Name: The Actor Who Played Space Tarzan
Description: The man playing Space Tarzan had a large, muscular build. He met Nobita in the park and sadly told him the show was likely to be cancelled. Moved by Nobita's pleas, he reconsidered.

Character Name: Great Demon King of the Universe
Description: The villain from the tokusatsu film Space Great Demon God, based on the original work by Dekisugi-kun. Gian plays the role of the protagonist.
The main character of the TV show Space Detective Saraba. He fought against a space monster but was defeated by the effect of the One-Shot Comeback Bomb.

A pilot who set out to explore a star far from Earth appeared on TV Nobita and his friends watched. He returned to Earth after one year, but because he traveled at near light speed, 100 years had passed on Earth.
The person who appeared on TV welcoming the space pilot back to Earth at the airport.
Source References: TenComi Volume 25, Page 145; FF Land Volume 33, Page 165; Complete Works Volume 10, Page 422

Description: A future criminal who stole a space rocket. In Nobita's time, he dropped a bag containing secret gadgets from the future. He accidentally saw Nobita's face.
Shizuka brought a monkey plushie named Ukki. It was mischievous and quick. It befriended skeletons using the Screw of Life.

Character Name: The Old Man at the Horse Shop
Description: He became a sponsor of the broadcasting station that Nobitaro started. He runs a confectionery shop. With the sponsor's support, Nobitaro was able to continue his broadcasting activities.
The witch from the picture book The Little Mermaid. In exchange for the Little Mermaid's voice, she was supposed to give a potion turning the tail into legs.
The ghost Nobita produced in Assorted Ghosts. He can swim freely underwater and carried Nobita, who could not swim, on his back.
Source References: TenComi Volume 31, Page 24; FF Land Volume 39, Page 102; Complete Works Volume 11, Page 606

Description: A sea monster from the time of Captain Kidd attacked the ship Nobita and his friends were on. It was a synthetically modified organism developed by the Inca civilization.
Doraemon was greatly inflated by a fake fishing hook that Nobita's dad caught.
Source References: TenComi Volume 31, Page 23; FF Land Volume 39, Page 101; Complete Works Volume 11, Page 639

Description: He saved a turtle and was invited to the Dragon Palace at the bottom of the sea. In the summer of 1049, he went missing at sea and reappeared in 1317 (canonically speaking, in the Doraemon universe).
A hero of justice in the tokusatsu film Space Great Demon God, based on Dekisugi-kun's original work. A boy whose town was burned down was given power and fought as a hero.
A hero who appears in the TV show Uratorman. He has a body similar to Ultraman's. Due to the Magic Clock, he was forced to fight many times and became so tired he fainted on air.
The transfer student was downcast because his father was a sailor and could not come home often. Using the Continuous Reflection Mirror, Uranari talked to his father who was at sea.
He is a sailor who cannot go home very often. He is Uranari-kun's father.
Source References: TenComi Volume 22, Page 141; FF Land Volume 31, Page 121; Complete Works Volume 9, Page 314

Description: A salesman in the new product sales department of Mirai Department Store. Competition with rival companies is fierce, and they prevent product information leaks.
The old man in the house Nobita said was noisy. He has straight, long eyebrows extending beyond his head. He got angry when he saw Gian and his gang vandalizing the wall outside.
The name Suneo used when he was a hero in his dream. He looked just like Super Dan.
The TV hero that Gian watched. He fights monsters.
The main character of Ultra Boy, a popular TV show Nobita and his friends watch. He wore a cape and form-fitting suit. His abilities are unknown but he can fly. He could crash through walls.
A hero in the TV show Ultra One. He has a dog-like face and body resembling Ultraman Seven.
The homeowner where Nobita took refuge from a car. The house is at the end of a sharp curve, so dump trucks often crash into it. Just as Doraemon and others were talking, a truck crashed in.
An older woman practiced driving in her backyard. Nobita, who had trespassed into the garden, was almost run over.
Source References: TenComi Volume 1, Page 29; FF Land Volume 2, Page 176; Complete Works Volume 1, Page 45

Description: The person who lent Nobita's dad the karaoke set.
This character appeared in materials for the debate Does Nessie Exist or Not?. In 1934 he saw the Loch Ness Monster and documented the experience. He was a fisheries manager.
Nobita's friend mentioned when Nobita was persuading his parents to stop hiring a tutor.
Source References: TenComi Volume 33, Page 159; FF Land Volume 41, Page 137; Complete Works Volume 13, Page 503

Description: An ancestor of Lotte Munchausen. Five hundred years ago, they built Munchausen Castle. He was a large armored man who left treasure for his descendants.
An older painter struggled because his paintings were not selling. When he pawned a painting, it fetched 1 million yen, and art gallery owners became interested.
A painter drawn by Doraemon using crayons. In exchange for teaching art, he demanded food. He asked Nobita's mom Who drew this? It's terrible, then drew her caricature.
Suneo's pet cat with a pedigree certificate. It ran away from home but came back a week later.
A character from the book Edison that Nobita received as a Christmas present. Thomas Alva Edison was an American inventor famous for the phonograph, incandescent light bulb, and other innovations.
